verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the new individual plan price as $15.99/month in April 2026 announcements.

verifications.claim: As of April 2026, YouTube Premium Family plans cost $26.99 per month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: the family plan (up to six accounts) is increasing from $22.99 to $26.99/month (R1); Premium Family plan now pay $26.99 a month, up from $22.99 (R2); family plan... increasing $4 to $26.99 a month (R4); Family: $26.99/month (R6); family plan... will also rise to $26.99 (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the family plan price increase to $26.99/month.

verifications.claim: YouTube Premium Lite plan costs $8.99 per month.

verifications.claim: YouTube Premium individual plan costs $159.99 per year.

verifications.claim: YouTube Premium Student plan requires verification.
verifications.label: OMITTED

verifications.claim: YouTube Premium Lite plan provides ad-free viewing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: provides ad-free video viewing (R1); removes ads from most videos (R3); lacks ads on most videos (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state Lite offers ad-free viewing (with minor qualifiers like 'most').

verifications.claim: YouTube Premium Lite plan does not include music.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: excludes songs and music videos (R1); doesn't include YouTube Music (R3); does not include access to YouTube Music (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated that Lite excludes music/YouTube Music.

verifications.claim: YouTube Music Premium costs $11.99 per month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: YouTube Music individual plan is increasing from $10.99 to $11.99/month (R1); YouTube Premium Music: $11.99 a month (R4); Music Premium: $11.99/month (R6); YouTube Music subscription is also rising $1 to $11.99 per month (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the exact price for YouTube Music individual.

verifications.claim: YouTube Music Premium is a standalone subscription.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: YouTube Music individual plan is increasing... (separate from Premium) (R1); YouTube Premium Music: $11.99 (distinct plan) (R4); Music Premium: $11.99/month (separate listing) (R6); YouTube Music subscription is also rising (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources treat YouTube Music as a distinct subscription with separate pricing, not bundled exclusively.

verifications.claim: All YouTube Premium plans provide ad-free viewing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: YouTube Premium’s key perk is ad-free viewing (R1); removes ads from most videos (Lite, R3); ad-free viewing (general Premium, R4); lacks ads on most videos (Lite, R7)
verifications.reasoning: All mentioned Premium plans (Individual, Family, Student, Lite) provide ad-free viewing.

verifications.claim: All YouTube Premium plans provide background play.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: background listening (Premium); Lite... does not let users... play videos in the background (R1); You still get background play... (Lite? but contradicts R1; R3 mentions for Lite but R1 explicit no)
verifications.reasoning: Lite explicitly does not provide background play, contradicting 'all'.

verifications.claim: All YouTube Premium plans provide offline downloads.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: offline video downloads (Premium); Lite... does not let users download videos for offline viewing (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Lite does not provide offline downloads, so not all plans do.

verifications.claim: YouTube Music is included in all YouTube Premium plans except Premium Lite.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: full access to YouTube Music (Premium); Lite... excludes songs and music videos (R1); doesn't include YouTube Music (Lite, R3); does not include access to YouTube Music (Lite, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Premium includes Music; Lite explicitly excludes it.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Existing customers will see the new pricing in their next billing cycle in June (R1); current subscribers told to expect updated prices... in June (R5); change in price will kick in during the June 2026 billing period (R6)
